answer.answer: Only one qualifying pair of same‑method Mediterranean ocean‑water studies falls within 50 km and one year of each other: Caldwell et al. 2019 (Manta net, median 0.0641) and Caldwell et al. 2020 (Manta net, median 0.4981), about 15 km apart and ~354 days apart. The factor between their medians is ≈7.77, which is also the median since it's the only pair available.
